status_scope: Status describes the explicitly named hypothesis and evidence_scope, not confirmation of physical GV. Synthetic-methodology successes are not physical evidence.

experiments.hypothesis: The frozen GV metric gives earlier blow-up warning than conventional observables for dx/dt=x^2.

dataset.description: Seeded stable and blow-up trajectories; 500 each per noise level; no archived raw dataset.

experiments.baseline: First and second derivatives and other frozen scalar observables; strongest is abs(d2x/dt2).
experiments.success_criterion: Control-calibrated 5% target FPR and GV median warning lead exceeding every conventional detector median, including 10% noise; implemented FPR tolerance is one percentage point.
experiments.result: Difference of detector medians (not median paired difference): 0, 0, 0, -0.001370 at 0%, 1%, 5%, 10% noise.
experiments.interpretation: No incremental warning value for this formulation.
limitations: Toy ODE only; raw trajectories are not archived.
Protocol names a trajectory-wise primary comparison, but the implementation/report use a difference of population medians, not a median paired difference.
Control FPR is evaluated on calibration data; no held-out FPR or confidence interval is established.

experiments.hypothesis: The frozen composite warns earlier of inviscid Burgers shock formation.

dataset.description: Seeded analytic Burgers trajectories with nonoverlapping control/active amplitudes; no raw archive.

experiments.baseline: Frozen individual Burgers diagnostics.
experiments.success_criterion: Positive warning advantage over the strongest individual baseline at matched FPR, including high noise.
experiments.result: All median warning times tie; median paired advantage is zero at all noise levels.
experiments.interpretation: Historical negative verdict retained; initial-distribution confound weakens the precursor test.
limitations: Controls A in [0.10,0.40], actives A in [1,2]; initial separation permits immediate alarms.

experiments.hypothesis: An equal-weight composite adds warning lead in forced viscous Burgers with overlapping initial conditions.

dataset.description: Seeded controls and delayed-forcing actives; 160/160 active events; no raw archive.

experiments.baseline: Total variation strongest at 0%, 1%, 5%; gradient energy at 10%.
experiments.success_criterion: Pass validity checks and beat every individual baseline with positive paired lead advantage including 10% noise.
experiments.interpretation: Technically valid corrective benchmark; GV worse than simpler baselines.
limitations: Specific forcing and finite-resolution simulated regime; shrinking deficit with noise is post-hoc, not support.

experiments.hypothesis: Frozen composite adds warning value in forced two-dimensional Navier-Stokes.

dataset.description: 60 control and 60 active trajectories; no raw archive.

experiments.baseline: Maximum vorticity, enstrophy, maximum strain, kinetic energy, palinstrophy, dissipation.
experiments.success_criterion: At least 70% active events, at most 10% control events and initial GV alarms, then positive baseline advantage.
experiments.result: Active event incidence 20/60 = 0.333, below 0.700; solver finite and control rate zero.
experiments.interpretation: Not a valid supportive or negative detector-performance test; historical BENCHMARK INVALID preserved.
limitations: Insufficient active event incidence; lead comparisons are exploratory only.

experiments.hypothesis: The unchanged F2 composite adds warning value after a separately frozen corrective physical regime.

dataset.description: New 2026-10-05 run, seed 20260910, NumPy 2.4.6; 60 controls and 60 actives; trajectories generated in memory.

experiments.baseline: Same six F2 baselines; vorticity and strain give 100% pre-event detection at every noise level.
experiments.success_criterion: Implemented validity gates plus GV beating all baseline medians and positive paired delta at every frozen noise level.
experiments.result: Validity gates pass; 60/60 active events, zero controls. GV detections 5/60, 1/60, 0/60, 0/60; paired deltas -0.76, -0.74, undefined, undefined.
experiments.interpretation: Corrected regime does not rescue the frozen composite; simpler diagnostics are stronger.
limitations: New computational run, not independent physical replication.
Conditional medians omit misses; baseline palinstrophy has low detection despite long conditional lead.
Finite-value checks do not establish solver convergence; FPR is in-sample.

experiments.hypothesis: Timing-only classifiers separate injected propagation from known artifacts.

dataset.description: Toy null, c-like and 0.90c injections, plus adversarial nulls.

experiments.baseline: Random null and known timing/cable/clock/EM models.
experiments.success_criterion: Low false positives and high injection power; historical early screening, not a physical discovery threshold.
experiments.result: Simple-null FPR about 0% and power about 99%; cable and clock artifacts defeat the approach.
experiments.interpretation: Works on easy encoded models, not sufficient identification under realistic alternatives.
limitations: No physical data; not all obsolete classifiers are retained in executable form.

experiments.hypothesis: Early timing/control classifiers reliably reject instrumental explanations while retaining spatial injections.

dataset.description: Historical five failed approaches documented in failure notes; raw trial records absent.

experiments.baseline: Cable, common clock, EM, correlated noise, flexible linear fits.
experiments.success_criterion: Reject known artifacts without eliminating injection detection power.
experiments.result: Adversarial FPR about 33.47%; flexible fit unexplained rate about 50.98%; first control matrix FPR about 21.76%; first clock correction FPR=0 and TPR=0.
experiments.interpretation: Reject these identification approaches; low residual or zero FPR alone is insufficient.
limitations: Exact reproduction of superseded implementations unavailable; current corrected code cannot reproduce every historical failure.

experiments.hypothesis: Independent slopes by reassigned clock reject modeled clock bias without rejecting spatial injections.

dataset.description: Seeded modeled clocks and detector positions.

experiments.baseline: Clock-specific timing artifact and ordinary EM propagation.
experiments.success_criterion: Reject clock artifact, retain spatial injection; EM may correctly survive this gate.
experiments.result: Failure notes report 0% clock artifact survival and 100% injected spatial survival.
experiments.interpretation: Supports this modeled clock-control method only, not physical GV.
limitations: Model-specific simulation; ordinary EM also survives; no hardware calibration.

experiments.hypothesis: EM-specific modeled interventions classify encoded electromagnetic coupling.

dataset.description: Shielding, orientation, source-power and modulation models.

experiments.baseline: Injected conventional EM pathway.
experiments.success_criterion: EM model classified KNOWN EM CHANNEL, rather than an unexplained candidate.
experiments.result: Archived master protocol seed 102 classifies EM as known EM.
experiments.interpretation: Supports encoded EM-control logic, not measured isolation or GV.
limitations: Shielding response is assumed in the generator; no real sensor data.

experiments.hypothesis: Modeled mechanical, acoustic and thermal effects are attributed to environmental pathways.

dataset.description: Encoded environmental interventions.

experiments.baseline: Mechanical, acoustic and thermal propagation/drift models.
experiments.success_criterion: All three known environmental injections receive KNOWN ENVIRONMENTAL CHANNEL.
experiments.result: Archived master seeds 103, 104, 105 receive known environmental classifications.
experiments.interpretation: Supports modeled attribution only, not exclusion of actual environmental causes.
limitations: Unmodeled confounds cannot be excluded by this simulation.

experiments.hypothesis: Sequential gates produce the six specified synthetic scenario classifications.

dataset.description: Six seeded scenario records, 101 through 106.

experiments.baseline: Known clock, EM, mechanical, acoustic and thermal models.
experiments.success_criterion: Five conventional scenarios classified as known and the intentionally injected candidate survives modeled gates.
experiments.result: Archived six-scenario audit matches all specified verdicts.
experiments.interpretation: Software plumbing check only; injected model name gv is not physical GV detection.
limitations: Not independent of generator assumptions; no comprehensive composite-null validation or physical replication.
Each gate generates its own model-specific dataset; this is not one measured signal surviving a joint sequence of controls.

experiments.hypothesis: Historical claims that a toy energy-density integral derives observed Lambda and entropy repayment.

dataset.description: Assumed density profile, target Lambda and stipulated damping efficiency, not observations.

experiments.baseline: Assumed replication without versus with imposed 99% damping; not validated thermodynamics.
experiments.success_criterion: No locked independent prediction or valid empirical success criterion.
experiments.result: Attempted target fitting fails: current toy prints Lambda 5.844e-237 against 1.1056e-52, relative error 1.00, and entropy proxy -1.292e27. These outputs contradict historical precision/entropy claims; encoded damping establishes no physical mechanism.
experiments.interpretation: Not an evidential test; historical strong conclusions are unsupported.
limitations: Dimension/normalization unresolved; current numerical output does not reproduce the historical claimed agreement.
Negative toy entropy is not validated physical entropy.
Finite toy simulations cannot establish eternal behavior.

experiments.hypothesis: Encoded feedback reduces a simulated strain variable and labels some nodes aligned.

dataset.description: Six evolving toy prototypes; some are unseeded; no archived controlled measurements.

experiments.baseline: Ordinary feedback and assumed damping within the same generator.
experiments.success_criterion: No preregistered GV-specific comparison.
experiments.result: Aligned labels follow programmed thresholds; not evidence that GV caused alignment.
experiments.interpretation: Illustrations only, not a controlled transition-signature test.
limitations: No preregistration, held-out data, independent control or physical replication; not promoted as reproducible evidence.

experiments.hypothesis: Seeded toy monitors trigger after modeled drift and expose programmed recoverability loss.

dataset.description: Seeds 7, 11 and 23; CI summaries are software outputs, not physical data.

experiments.baseline: Encoded kick/warm-up and magnitude bounds; no GV-specific competing physical model.
experiments.success_criterion: The three existing assertions pass with the specified seeds and thresholds.
experiments.result: Pre-edit baseline: 3 tests passed on Python 3.11.16.
experiments.interpretation: Supports these software assertions only; not evidence for physical GV or a new mechanism.
limitations: Generator assumptions encode deterioration; tests are not an independent benchmark against alternative detectors.

experiments.hypothesis: In a low-energy relay transition, a time-localized joint residual recurs above shams and survives tested known pathways and locked independent-session replication.

dataset.description: No physical acquisition. Generated mock arrays are pipeline tests only and are not physical datasets or experimental results.

experiments.baseline: Calibration-only known-pathway feature model, held-out shams, eight diagnostic control families; simple peak/RMS comparisons required before stronger claims.
experiments.success_criterion: Prospective active-minus-sham residual-flag rate >=0.10, conservative 95% difference lower bound >0, sham 95% upper bound <=0.05, valid counts/controls/sensitivity, and unchanged independent-session repeat. Not a GV-confirmation rule.
experiments.result: STATUS: DESIGN / NOT RUN. Apparatus selection, measured calibration, physical adapter and control approval incomplete. Synthetic injections test software only.
experiments.interpretation: New physical-test design ready for adversarial pre-hardware review, not hardware-ready or evidence of a physical signature.
limitations: No physical data, noise floor or transfer-function measurement.
100 us timing target and mechanical counterfactual require apparatus review.
RF/other pathway coverage and correlated-event statistics remain unresolved.
No automatic physical success verdict; component-specific acquisition and comparison/control integration require later validation.
